_comment: 26.2 (unobfuscated, deferred-render rewrite) mixin subset. Dropped vs fpsmaster.mixins.json: the complex render/screen mixins that target pre-26 immediate/submit-node internals (MixinChatComponent, MixinEditBox, MixinEntityRenderer, MixinGuiGraphics, MixinItemEntityRenderer, MixinLevelRenderer, MixinLightTexture, MixinLivingEntityRenderer, MixinNameTagFeatureRenderer, MixinPlayerTabOverlay, MixinScreen, MixinScreenEffectRenderer, MixinScreenHud) — deferred; their sources are excluded in build.gradle.kts. MixinGui IS kept (HUD draw hook ported to Gui.extractRenderState). Keep in sync with the build.gradle.kts isUnobfuscated exclusion list. Also dropped (config-only; source still compiles): MixinClientLevelData — 26.2 replaced ClientLevelData.dayTime/getDayTime with the new WorldClock/ClockManager system (Level.getDefaultClockTime/getClockTimeTicks), so its @Shadow of dayTime fails to apply. TimeChanger is a no-op on 26.2 until ported to WorldClock.
